Based on who the mainstream media has tried to demonise and cancel over the past decade, it seems they have a problem with ANY man who effectively communicates with young men.

The core message isn't really the issue. The audience demographic is.
Good morning from Dubai. Storms coming...

The best predictor of future behaviour is past behaviour.

That doesn't mean people can't change, far from it. But it means they normally don't.
I'm feeling particularly blessed today. We thank God. 🙏🏾

I have many questions...

Focusing on the latter isn't any more 'real' than focusing on the former. But it will certainly make you more miserable.

It's never too early to start learning about physical and mental fitness. 💪🏾

Be cautious out there.
